desc: Bulgarian-made SAM7K pistol is ideal for sport shooting, self-defense, and for pistol hunting. It features a rear Quick Detach port and threaded front sight block with standard Krink configuration with 24x1.5mm RH threads. It also combines authentic, high-quality features rarely seen in the American market. Arsenals hot-die hammer forging produces stronger and finer-grained steel. The SAM7K comes with one 5-round magazine, oil bottle, cleaning rod, cleaning kit.
